derived_rationale.FamilySize: SibSp + Parch + 1; survival is non-monotonic in family size, so the raw counts split the signal in two.
derived_rationale.IsAlone: FamilySize == 1; a single threshold that the trees find anyway but linear models cannot express.
derived_rationale.Title: Extracted from Name (Mr/Mrs/Miss/Master/rare). Carries sex and rough age together, and survives Age being 20% missing.
derived_rationale.Deck: First letter of Cabin, with a missing category. Cabin itself is 77% missing and near-unique among observed rows, so the letter is the only part that generalises.
derived_rationale.AgeMissing: Indicator for a missing Age. Whether the age was recorded is itself informative; imputing it away discards that.
